critical_code_review_comments: leagues_router.py L104 _upsert_league_user now coerces email:None -> '' on both the existing-user backfill branch and the initial insert branch. Correct fix for the P0. The fallback_name derivation also handles email=None safely (uses 'player' when both name and email are None).

POST /api/rounds/{id}/finalize (L815) correctly returns 400 with 'Certification required...' when certified=false, guards director-only via _require_member + role check, only touches unfinalized scorecards ({finalized:{$ne:True}}), stamps 'DIRECTOR SWEEP' in certified_by_name and writes a ProofLog audit row with edited_by_name containing 'DIRECTOR SWEEP-CERTIFIED'. WebSocket broadcast on completion also fires. Good.

leagues_clubhouse_router.py Phase-1 refactor reuses the same api_router instance imported from leagues_router — attaches to same URL surface, no double-mount, no duplicated auth shim. Circular-import risk resolved via bottom-of-file import in leagues_router.py L1681. Clean.

auth_router.py L112 POST /api/users/me/dm-terms/agree is idempotent (only writes if dm_terms_agreed_at is falsy) and returns full ProfileOut so the frontend can mirror the new timestamp without a follow-up fetch. Correct.

LeagueDetail.jsx lifts ClubhouseAgreementModal above the tab switcher so it covers rounds/standings/ledger/clubhouse tabs uniformly. Verified in browser — modal appears on the default 'rounds' tab. Good.

MessageComposeModal.jsx wires dm-terms-gate + dm-terms-agree-btn to POST /users/me/dm-terms/agree with message-compose-send disabled when gate is showing. Code review confirms the disabled state on send button. Live click-through not executed this iter but backend endpoint is proven.

Minor (not a bug, note for later): _upsert_league_user still uses `fb_user.get('name')` for fallback_name derivation. In dev-mode signup with only email/password the Firebase decoded token often has no `name` claim, so the fallback lands on the local-part of the email — that's the correct behavior.
